leah (PM): Heads-up: I'm drafting an "Accuracy vs Cost" routing framework for upcoming model candidate experiments. Goal: let product teams run controlled A/Bs that measure quality uplift per-token cost delta, with strong rollback/opt-out and clear launch gates. Sharing a sketch for feedback.

omar (SRE): Love this. Two operational things: 1) add a hard budget throttle per-candidate (tokens/sec) so a noisy candidate can't blow past commit. 2) require a fallback circuit that routes to baseline or a cheaper quantized variant if GPU queue latency exceeds threshold.

leah (PM): Good call on budget throttle. My sketch has three lanes: 
- Shadow evaluation (no user impact) 72h
- Controlled A/B (hold-out cohorts, deterministic hashing) 48-168h
- Progressive regional ramp (by region/tenant slices)
Kill triggers at each lane.

dave (Eng): On hashing: use tenant_id + session_id as seed to avoid splitting sessions. For mobile clients, prefer device_id cookie fallback. Also recommend sticky routing at cohort granularity (user stays with variant for 7 days).

jin (DevEx): Telemetry plan: tag every event with `experiment_id`, `variant`, `cohort_hash`, `cost_tokens`, `inference_ms`. Wire a small sampler (0.5%) to capture full prompt/response pairs for offline quality eval — with redaction. Dashboards: exp.{id}.overview, exp.{id}.p95_latency, exp.{id}.avg_cost_per_resp, exp.{id}.quality_delta.

tara (Product Ops): For customer-driven asks, expose `experiment.optin` toggle in Console + a managed whitelist. Pilot customers must sign an opt-in form and accept a 72h bake window for >15% traffic. We'll also surface projected cost delta on the Console before they opt in.

alyssa (Security): Important: sampled prompt/response pairs must be redacted before leaving the infra. For Private deployments require that the sampling exporter is disabled by default and can only be enabled with a KMS-bound policy and explicit customer consent. No cross-tenant aggregation.

leah (PM): Decision metric: primary = quality uplift (embedding-similarity A->B aggregated by prompt-family) normalized by cost delta per-1000 tokens. Secondary = latency p95, error-rate. We define a composite "efficiency score" = (quality_delta_pct) / (cost_delta_per_k tokens). Promote if score > configured threshold and latency/error gates pass.

dave (Eng): Suggest we codify MDE (minimum detectable effect) per experiment given traffic. Maybe add a quick guide in PRD: for 100k impressions, MDE ~ 0.8% (stats assumptions listed). For small tenants we default to within-tenant paired tests (shadow + offline evaluation) rather than live-split.

omar (SRE): Operational gates: p95 latency regressions > 15% OR absolute p95 > 400ms -> auto-rollback. Error-rate jump > 0.2ppt -> auto-rollback. Budget overrun > 110% of committed tokens/minute -> throttle candidate to 0% and alert PD. Auto-rollback should be executed within 90s.

jin (DevEx): Quick example experiment config (will add to spec):
```yaml
experiment_id: exp-accuracy-cost-2026-01
variants:
  - id: baseline
  - id: v3_candidate
cohorts:
  - pct: 5
    seed: tenant_id
  - pct: 15
    seed: tenant_id
guards:
  latency_p95_ms: 400
  error_rate_pct: 0.2
  cost_delta_per_k_tokens_usd: 0.05
analysis_window: 168h
mde_target_pct: 0.8
```
This can be fed to the flagger/telemetry service.

leah (PM): Analysis protocol: run two-tier checks — online metric gates during rollout + offline paired-quality eval on sampled prompts. If online gates pass but offline quality shows regression > configured MDE, we hold promotion and require manual review.

tara (Product Ops): Reporting: produce a short experiment report template: hypothesis, traffic slices, cost projection, MDE, online gate results, offline eval summary, recommendation (promote/rollback/iterate). Ops will require this before approving production promotion.

alyssa (Security): Also require a privacy sign-off box in the report for any experiment exporting prompt/response pairs. The report must list redaction transforms and retention TTL.

omar (SRE): Capacity note: annotate regional capacity ceilings in experiment ticket (gpu-pool counts, spare headroom). If region capacity < needed, restrict that region to shadow-only.

dave (Eng): For feature flags, recommend layering: global experiment flag (on/off) + cohort selector + telemetry sampling flag + per-tenant override. Auto-expire flags after X days to avoid stale experiments.

jin (DevEx): I'll wire a workspace template for experiment dashboards and a one-click "snapshot" export for the experiment report. Also add a small eval harness that runs offline paired tests and computes bootstrap CIs.

leah (PM): Customer communication: When enabling tenant opt-ins, surface the expected SLA impact and cost delta. Include contact for rapid opt-out and a hotfix path if issues observed.

tara (Product Ops): For negotiated scopes, we'll add a standard clause: pilot customers can request a custom cohort or extended bake, but any SLA exceptions must be approved by SRE/Support and legal.

omar (SRE): Escalation: on-call runbook step 1: flip `experiment.global_override` -> baseline, notify PG + PD, open incident channel. Step 2: if degraded capacity, enable model-fallback-policy to quantized fallback variant. We'll keep runbook under ops/playbooks/experiment-rollback.

leah (PM): Next actions: Jin to create dashboard template + sample eval harness, Dave to draft flag schema PR, Omar to finalize SRE thresholds + runbook snippets, Alyssa to draft privacy checklist, Tara to draft experiment report template. Shiproom Thursday to sign off.

deploy-bot: deploy started: exp-config/3502000001 -> rolling flags for 5% cohort (dry-run).

dave (Eng): I'll submit the PR by EOD with schema + example. Will include CLI: `rw exp apply --file exp-accuracy-cost.yaml --dry-run`.

jin (DevEx): Noted. I'll also add instructions for running offline paired eval locally (`rw eval pair --sample prod-smoke-v3`).

alyssa (Security): Will circulate the privacy checklist and the KMS gating steps this afternoon.

leah (PM): Thanks team. Please comment on the draft doc in the repo. If there are no blockers we'll go to shiproom and try to land the baseline infra next week.
